noResultsYet: No results available for this matchday yet.
notSailedYet: No races sailed yet. The pairing list is ready.
noRacesDrawn: No races drawn for this matchday yet.
pairingCaption: Pairing list: teams by boat and race
resultsFocusHint: Races run one at a time, so only the previous, current, and next race are shown.
resultsAllHint: Showing every race — use this to correct an older result.
projectedTooltip: Provisional final total: current points plus this team's expected average per race for the remaining flights — its own average once it has sailed, or the fair expected value of a single result ((boats + 1) / 2) before it has. Not an official result and never used for ranking; click to sort by it (highest first), click again to go back to the official rank order.
projectedFlightTooltip: This flight is under way but this team hasn't sailed it yet — shown as its expected average for a single race, not a real result.
tapAssignLabel: Assign the next finish position to {{boat}}
duplicatePositionWarning: Two boats have the same finish position. Fix that before saving.
redressSuggested: Suggested: {{value}} (RRS A10 average of this team's other scored races)

codeTooltip.FINISHED: Scored by finish position — no penalty.
codeTooltip.DNS: Did not start. Scored as {{points}} points (starters + 1) — worse than finishing last.
codeTooltip.DNF: Did not finish. Scored as {{points}} points (starters + 1) — worse than finishing last.
codeTooltip.OCS: On course side / early start. Scored as {{points}} points (starters + 1) — worse than finishing last.
codeTooltip.DSQ: Disqualified. Scored as {{points}} points (starters + 1) — worse than finishing last.
codeTooltip.DNE: Disqualification not excludable. Scored as {{points}} points (starters + 1) — worse than finishing last, and never discarded even when discards apply.
codeTooltip.RET: Retired. Scored as {{points}} points (starters + 1) — worse than finishing last.
codeTooltip.ZFP: Scoring penalty: finish position + 20% of starters (min. 1 point), capped at {{cap}} points (never worse than DNF). This race's penalty is {{penalty}} points.
codeTooltip.SCP: Scoring penalty: finish position + 20% of starters (min. 1 point), capped at {{cap}} points (never worse than DNF). This race's penalty is {{penalty}} points.
codeTooltip.RDG: Redress: the jury enters the awarded points directly — they are not computed automatically.
